name: Litopys
description: Chapters and facts per chat. A worker cuts the story into scenes and, for each closed scene, writes one chapter (what changed, not a retelling) and the durable facts that came with it into data/litopys/chats/<chat>.json. Shadow mode: nothing is added to the prompt yet. The 1.x store (data/litopys/store.json) is read once to carry old facts over, then left as a backup. Formerly Archivarius.
